items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: So, your record was the first one with the knock on the door--a way before Jack McVea made his hit record.

ctx.x: rehearsed...uh, I can't think of the song. It was very popular at that time, and we went out to this Hollywood studio to make the record, and when we got there, there was a big white band playing the same thing that we was gonna play--the same tune, so we didn't have anything else rehearsed, and so they said, "Whatta we gonna do, Reb?" I say, "We'll play a bunch of blues, and we'll call it 'Sheffield Blues'," and I say, "We'll start off like the...we'll start to playin', and then there'll be a knock on the door…
Oh, that'd be fun to hear. So, your record was the first one with the knock on the door--a way before Jack McVea made his hit record.
Oh, yeah. Uh, Little Richard...or what is it?
